playstyle.identity: Talon is a roaming assassin who can jump over any terrain in the game. He excels at bursting targets and disappearing before enemies can react.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive bleeds on 3 ability hits. Q is melee crit or ranged stab. W throws blades out and back. E jumps over any terrain (each terrain has cooldown). R goes invisible and throws blades that return on attack. W-Q for poke, R for all-in, E to roam everywhere.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Talon spikes at level 2-3 with burst combo and at 6 with R. Lethality items scale him. He's strongest mid-game roaming.

passive.name: Blade's End
passive.summary: Abilities stack wounds; at 3 stacks, auto attack bleeds the target.
passive.details: Talon's abilities apply Wound stacks. At 3 stacks, his next auto attack consumes them to deal bonus bleed damage.

abilities.name: Noxian Diplomacy
abilities.summary: Dash and stab; at melee range, deals critical damage.
abilities.details: Talon stabs a target. At close range, he critically strikes. At range, he leaps to the target. Refunds cooldown on kill.

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.summary: Throw blades that return, dealing damage and slowing.
abilities.details: Talon throws blades in a cone that return after a moment, dealing damage both ways. Returning blades slow.

abilities.name: Assassin's Path
abilities.summary: Jump over any terrain; each terrain has a cooldown.
abilities.details: Talon vaults over any terrain in the game. Each terrain segment has its own cooldown before he can use it again.

abilities.name: Shadow Assault
abilities.summary: Go invisible and throw blades outward; blades return on attack or recast.
abilities.details: Talon becomes invisible and throws blades outward. The blades return to him when he attacks or recasts, dealing damage.
